Based on the evidence, the **Enterprise segment offers the strongest growth quality**.

- **Satisfaction:** It holds the highest NPS at **52** [NL-012-S03], and this is consistent with qualitative feedback showing they have the highest satisfaction once fully onboarded, supported by dedicated CSMs [NL-011-S08].
- **Churn:** It has the lowest monthly logo churn at **1.3%** [NL-012-S03], described as "extremely stable" [NL-016-S03].
- **Expansion:** It generated the highest expansion revenue at **$91,000**, representing **52.6% of all expansion revenue** [NL-012-S03] [NL-012-S05]. Expansion events are driven by scaling to new departments and custom SSO integrations [NL-012-S05].

**Why it still requires more implementation capacity:** The Enterprise segment has the longest onboarding duration, averaging **8.7 weeks** [NL-012-S03], due to permission-mapping challenges and security reviews [NL-016-S03]. This long onboarding makes customer onboarding a "resource constraint," requiring automated tools to streamline permission mapping and improve document cleanup [NL-012-S09]. Additionally, enterprise sentiment is vulnerable to delays during the implementation phase, and these clients require dedicated CSM support for complex compliance and security priorities (e.g., detailed compliance reviews, custom DPAs) [NL-011-S08].
